question: What is the structure of the three-syllable Kṛṣṇa mantra?
premises: This is a mantra of Kṛṣṇa.
It is placed within the love-seed.
inference: The Kṛṣṇa mantra is a three-syllable formula set within the kāma-bīja.
plain_english: This Kṛṣṇa mantra, placed within the love-seed, is considered to have three syllables.
